title: The Princess Galva: A Romance

This reestablishes his connection to adventure when he encounters characters intertwined with his fate and a mysterious letter that hints at his involvement with an exiled princess. Whitelaw sets the stage for Edward’s transformation from a mundane clerk to a man embroiled in a grand narrative, intriguingly juxtaposing his ordinary life with the allure of romance and royal lineage.
